name: HAPPY SAIN† ZERO
original_name: HAPPY SAIN† ZERO ハッピーセイント-零-
source:
—This is the story of a very unusual man.

Two thousand years ago, a disaster swept through the land, corrupting all living things and making it to difficult to live on the land. For those that still wish to live on this dead land, a temple was established. It was known as Saint Sheol.

By the way, what was going on "behind the scenes" without the angels?

You are the cardinal of this temple. You must fight against various calamities and destroy heresy.

You are special, so please do try not to act alone.

Three bishops will assist you in your work.

Keep making the right choices and create a "better" world.
And listen... to the secret of that dazzling light you've been confronted with.
translation:
——这是一个非常不寻常的人的故事。

两千多年前，一场灾难席卷大地，腐蚀了万物，让大地难以生存。为了那些仍然希望在这片死寂的土地上生活的人，建立了一座寺庙。它被称为圣阴间。

顺便问一下，如果没有天使，“幕后”发生了什么？

你是这座寺庙的红衣主教。你必须对抗各种灾难，消灭异端。

你很特别，所以请尽量不要单独行动。

三位主教将协助你的工作。

不断做出正确的选择，创造一个“更好”的世界。
聆听……你所面对的耀眼光芒的秘密。
